items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Al C, little fella they call Dad. You don't look at him. [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know Dad.

ctx.x: Jules was playing trombone. Trombone. Yeah.
He's playing trombone with me then. You remember him? No, I don't. No. I never remember. Al C, little fella they call Dad. You don't look at him.
I don't know Dad. That Vincent, his name is Vincent.
